media.title: ProKinetic renders agent-written motion and exposes parameters for human tuning

title: AI Writes the Motion; a Human Tunes the Feel
summary: Mumo describes a workflow where Claude Code or Codex generates native motion, ProKinetic renders it, and tunable values appear as live controls. A human adjusts timing and feel at native refresh rates, then exports the chosen parameters back to the agent and source files.
takeaway: Expose spring, duration, delay, and damping values as live controls. Let the agent create the animation structure, but require a human to tune and approve the final motion on-device.
